title: Insurance Policies
description: Every car, home, and health insurance policy held by the household. Stores insurer, policy number, type, coverage details, premium, renewal date, broker, and notes.

type.description: Policy type: car, home, or health

insurer.description: Insurance company — AXA, Piraeus, MetLife, etc.

policy_number.description: Unique policy identifier, e.g. AX-7741-VAULT, PIR-HOME-882

coverage_details.description: What and who is covered — vehicle plates, property address, perils, co-pay details, coverage amounts

renewal_date.description: Next renewal date in ISO 8601 format

broker.description: Broker name and agency, e.g. Nikoleta @ Asfalia Pros

notes.description: Free-text notes — policyholder name, AFM, vehicle details, special clauses
